_comment: The one definition of how the 'what do you want automated?' answer splits into a checklist. Read by BOTH src/company/setup.rs (job_items) and frontend/src/lib/company-setup.ts (jobItems). Two implementations of one rule is how the first version of this feature drifted; this file is the reason they cannot. Add a case here before changing either implementation.

cases.why: the ordinary case: a comma list, in the order they wrote it
cases.input: class schedule reminders, restocking mats, chasing unpaid invoices

cases.why: semicolons and newlines are list separators too
prose with no separator is ONE item, and coverage is then trivially satisfied — the honest answer, not a failure
cases.input: I want the whole back office to just run itself really
items: I want the whole back office to just run itself really

cases.why: trailing full stops and stray whitespace are noise, not content
a repeated job must not make the list impossible to cover
nothing typed is an empty checklist, never a checklist of one empty string
past MAX_JOBS a checklist is a backlog; the tail is dropped rather than shipped to a prompt
cases.input: a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o
